scope: Single-visit spatial-token anatomical proxy comparison on reused developmental LUMIERE patients; no SAILOR or temporal JEPA training
limits: Reused scoring patients provide development evidence, not untouched confirmation
Automated masks and volumes are imperfect proxies, not expert biological truth
Architecture, initialization, and sequence processing differ together
Shared schedule is not proof of optimal or converged fitting for either architecture
Two fitted seeds do not characterize general training-seed uncertainty
The common coarse token budget does not test denser spatial representations
Synthetic nuisance and zero-image companions do not certify scanner robustness
Anatomical readout quality does not establish temporal JEPA benefit
No independent scientific review or foundation-pretraining patient-overlap audit occurred

verification.scope: Numerical verification within the implementing workflow; not independent scientific review
